$Comment: What the Headless Horseman's hard daily Claim (Rewards/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Daily_Hard)
pays: Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Daily.json's rolls at better amounts and odds. Every roll is read on
its own: the first three always pay, the rest are chances on top, two at Lantern Bombs and then
one each at the plain pieces of his armour (the Horseman's Breastplate, Gauntlets and Greaves,
members of the Hallowed set). The Claim keeps each roll a player wins with a chance equal to
their share of the fight. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100. Sweets and festival tokens pay
through the Currency reward kind; a companion mod adds rolls with a file naming this table in
Name: Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Daily_Hard
